import numpy as np

def filter_api_calls(log_probs_plus, log_probs_empty, log_probs_call_only, tau_filter):
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(log_probs_plus, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(log_probs_empty, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(log_probs_call_only, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if log_probs_plus.ndim != 2 or log_probs_empty.ndim != 2 or log_probs_call_only.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
    shape = log_probs_plus.shape
    if log_probs_empty.shape != shape or log_probs_call_only.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match")
    if shape[0] == 0 or shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must not be empty")
    if not (np.isfinite(log_probs_plus).all() and np.isfinite(log_probs_empty).all() and np.isfinite(log_probs_call_only).all()):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must contain only finite values")
    if not ((log_probs_plus <= 0).all() and (log_probs_empty <= 0).all() and (log_probs_call_only <= 0).all()):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a nonnegative scalar")
    
    H = shape[1]
    t = np.arange(H)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalizer = np.sum(raw_weights)
    weights = raw_weights / normalizer
    
    def weighted_loss(log_probs):
        return -np.sum(log_probs * weights, axis=1)
    
    L_plus = weighted_loss(log_probs_plus)
    L_empty = weighted_loss(log_probs_empty)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(log_probs_call_only)
    
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    mask = margins >= tau_filter
    return mask, margins

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")

import numpy as np

def filter_api_calls(log_probs_plus, log_probs_empty, log_probs_call_only, tau_filter):
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(log_probs_plus, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(log_probs_empty, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(log_probs_call_only, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if log_probs_plus.ndim != 2 or log_probs_empty.ndim != 2 or log_probs_call_only.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
    shape = log_probs_plus.shape
    if log_probs_empty.shape != shape or log_probs_call_only.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match")
    if shape[0] == 0 or shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must not be empty")
    if not (np.isfinite(log_probs_plus).all() and np.isfinite(log_probs_empty).all() and np.isfinite(log_probs_call_only).all()):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must contain only finite values")
    if not ((log_probs_plus <= 0).all() and (log_probs_empty <= 0).all() and (log_probs_call_only <= 0).all()):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a nonnegative scalar")
    
    H = shape[1]
    t = np.arange(H)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalizer = np.sum(raw_weights)
    weights = raw_weights / normalizer
    
    def weighted_loss(log_probs):
        return -np.sum(log_probs * weights, axis=1)
    
    L_plus = weighted_loss(log_probs_plus)
    L_empty = weighted_loss(log_probs_empty)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(log_probs_call_only)
    
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    mask = margins >= tau_filter
    return mask, margins
